title: Question about a withdrawn application that has already been paid

articles.subject: Question about a withdrawn application that has already been paid
articles.body:
Hi,

Sorry for writing from my private address, I am at home and could not get into the work laptop.

I am a caseworker in the grants unit at Nordstad kommun. I have an association that withdrew its application after we had already made the first disbursement. In Grantly I cannot set the case to withdrawn, the system says the case has payments and refuses.

How do I handle this so the bookkeeping stays correct? The applicant wants to return the money. Anna is away until Monday and the association is calling every day.

Best,
Karin

articles.subject: Re: Question about a withdrawn application that has already been paid
articles.body:
Hi Karin,

A case with a disbursement cannot be withdrawn directly, that is by design so that the payment history is not orphaned. The route is to register a repayment on the disbursement first, and once the paid amount is zero the case can be set to withdrawn.

Two things though. I cannot see which customer environment you are writing from since this address is not connected to an account, so I have answered generally. Please reply from your work address, or ask an administrator to, and I will look at the actual case.

Kind regards,
Sara Holm
Support lead, Minso
